functions.name: organization_membership_checks
functions.description: Organization/account membership visibility observations, not actual membership rows. Public and credential-visible checks preserve their distinct scopes; a negative public result does not prove absence of private membership.

metrics.name: organization_membership_check_count
metrics.comment: Selected membership visibility observations including unconfirmed results.

confirmed_organization_membership_check_.comment: Membership confirmed under the explicitly selected endpoint visibility; no claim about hidden private membership.

unconfirmed_organization_membership_chec.comment: Membership not confirmed under the explicitly selected endpoint visibility; no claim about hidden private membership.

routes.name: visible

arguments.name: organization
arguments.description: Explicit GitHub organization scope. Mutually exclusive with owner and repository.

arguments.name: membership_user
arguments.description: Account login whose organization membership or membership-check observation is selected.

arguments.name: organization_membership_check
arguments.description: Check visible membership or public membership. A 404 does not establish absence of a private membership.

routes.population: One visibility-scoped membership check. 204 confirms membership in this visibility scope; 404 means not confirmed and can hide a private membership. Permission errors fail.
